about_the_game:
This DLC is a Digital Art Book of Eye of Saccharine

Art Book is provided as a PDF file and written in English and Russian

A short story with comments about production by SasDeRider

Artbook PDF File Path : (Installation Path)\ArtBook

Example) E:\Program Files (x86)\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\EyeOfSaccharine\ArtBook

*This book consists of 47 pages. It includes all in game graphic, raw sketches and some development stages
